policy: Observed external values are used only with a one-period lag unless their advance availability is separately documented. Calendar features are calculated from the known target timestamp. Excluded variables are never passed to a model.

bases.notes: Daily OHLCV fields are treated conservatively as observed only after the day closes.
Observed weather is lagged. Holiday and weather categories stay excluded until their source and advance availability are formalized.
Environmental observations are available only as a prior-hour lag; calendar fields are rebuilt from the timestamp.
All meteorological observations are lagged by one hour.
Macro-rate publication timing is not documented, so the rates remain excluded until a conservative release-lag rule is approved.
